_doc: Use-based skills (docs/PLAYER_SYSTEMS.md §2). gain = base_xp x difficulty x (1 - level/110). feat: the deed summary the first time the skill is seen past 25/50/75

skills.name: Blades
skills.raised_by: hitting with swords, knives, and axes used as weapons

feat.25: handled a blade like someone who has been taught
feat.50: fought with a blade as well as any of the watch
feat.75: used a blade like a master swordsman

feat.25: swung a hammer with real weight behind it
feat.50: knocked grown men off their feet with a club
feat.75: fought with a hammer like a smith beats iron

skills.name: Bows
skills.raised_by: hitting with a bow or sling

feat.25: put an arrow where they meant it to go
feat.50: shot as well as a King's Ranger
feat.75: made shots at a distance few archers would try

feat.25: turned aside blows that should have landed
feat.75: could not be touched in a fight

feat.25: ran and climbed like a hill shepherd
feat.50: outran a horse on a short road
feat.75: went up a sheer wall like a cat

skills.name: Stealth
skills.raised_by: moving unseen near people and picking locks

feat.25: came and went without a sound
feat.50: slipped past a watchman under his nose
feat.75: moved like a shadow through a crowded room

feat.25: made a sound weld at the anvil
feat.50: forged a blade a smith would be proud of
feat.75: worked steel like a master of the trade

feat.25: dropped a tree exactly where they called it
feat.50: mended the mill wheel in an afternoon
feat.75: built in wood like a master joiner

skills.name: Herbcraft
skills.raised_by: gathering herbs, cooking and brewing remedies
effects: recipes the player can work out

feat.25: knew a root by its leaf
feat.75: knew more of herbs than the infirmarian

feat.25: worked a seam like a Greystone hand
feat.50: cut ore faster than the foreman's crew
feat.75: read the stone like the oldest miners do

skills.name: Speech
skills.raised_by: persuading, bargaining and calming a crowd
effects: how often talk ends a fight

feat.25: talked a hard bargain and won it
feat.50: talked an angry man out of a fight
feat.75: turned a crowd with a few words

skills.name: Lore
skills.raised_by: reading, solving lore puzzles and studying evidence

feat.25: read an old hand that stumps most clerks
feat.50: worked out what the evidence really said
feat.75: knew the old records better than an archivist
